name: Stephen Hawking
description: Stephen Hawking is one of the most recognizable people on the planet. From his scientific achievements to his personal strides with ALS, his life is ingrained in our collective history.

name: Technology
description: Despite suffering from debilitating motor neuron disease, Hawking has continued to push forward the boundaries of both physics and his own physical body. With the help of Intel and their highly advanced computer systems, Hawking is able to communicate his revolutionary theories with the world.

name: Space Technology
description: NASA recruited actor Eddie Redmayne, who portrays Hawking in the new biopic "The Theory of Everything," to make a short video honoring Hawking's contributions to science.

name: Elon Musk
description: SpaceX founder Elon Musk has stated that his company could land humans on Mars in the next 10 or 12 years and has commercial flights planned as well. Meanwhile Richard Branson's Virgin Galactic flights have already recruited Stephen Hawking as a passenger.

name: Space Travel
description: Stephen Hawking has advocated space travel as an essential opportunity to discover advancements and prolong survival of the human race.

name: Communication Technologies
description: As a result of his battle with ALS, Stephen Hawking’s limited mobility and inability to speak with his own voice has forced the scientist to rely on technology in order to communicate his brilliant thoughts and theories to the world.

name: iBrain
description: New technology using brain waves to communicate thoughts could help Stephen Hawking and other ALS sufferers who lack muscle movement.

name: Communication Time
description: Usually in interviews and speeches, Stephen Hawking has prepared answers, but Hawking was tested in an interview to see how long it took him to answer a question without prior preparation.

name: Blinks
description: Disabled scientist Professor Stephen Hawking is using a hi-tech gadget to communicate by blinking because his deteriorating health limits other movement.

name: Voice Technician
description: Interview with the man who is responsible for Hawking's voice technology.

name: Luddite
description: Stephen Hawking is comfortable with his current set-up so he is skeptical about altering his voice technology despite the availability of improvements.

name: Facebook
description: Since joining the social networking site in October of 2014, Hawking has already attained over a million "likes" and has been posting regularly.

name: Computers
description: Stephen Hawking’s voice and notable persona are literally and figuratively tied to the computer that allows him to communicate and operate.

name: Computer
description: Stephen Hawking describes how he uses his communication system on his official website.

name: Machines
description: Mialet tackles the role of the machine in Stephen Hawking's life and work and refers to the scientist as a "brain in a vat."

name: Health Technologies
description: Stephen Hawking is in the enviable position of having access to the latest and greatest technology to help him live fully and he is committed to making it easier for other disabled individuals to attain the necessary equipment.

name: Connected Wheelchair Project
description: New wheelchair from Intel helps disabled individuals communicate. In addition, it measures health information of the user and mechanical information of the chair.

name: Eye-Tracking
description: An Israeli start-up backed by predictive-keyboard-pioneer SwiftKey is offering hope for severely disabled individuals by allowing a computer to predict text based only on eye movements.

name: Intel
description: Stephen Hawking has been using Intel's advanced wheelchair technology for years and he's worked with them on developing new ways of improving the quality of life of disabled individuals.

name: Software
description: Despite requiring advanced technology to live comfortably, Stephen Hawking is resistant to making unnecessary or unpredictable advancements.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Hawking discourages filtering money to further artificial intelligence advancements and instead advocates research into what the effects of robotics and artificial intelligence could mean for the future.

name: Switches and Scanning
description: Since he suffers from ALS, Stephen Hawking is only able to write and operate from his computer using a "switch" that is activated by a muscle in his cheek.

name: Voice
description: Stephen Hawking's iconic synthesized voice was threatened when Intel suggested he upgrade it, but they decided to create a high-definition version to improve the quality instead.

name: Science
description: Stephen Hawking is widely accepted as one of the greatest minds in the universe, but he’s gained millions of followers because he made complex scientific theories accessible to the masses. His book, A Brief History of Time sold an astounding 20 million copies and included his theories about black holes and the Big Bang.

name: Phenomena
description: Stephen Hawking has explored a range of subjects in his quest to understand how the universe works.

name: Time Travel
description: Hawking contends that under Albert Einstein's general theory of relativity, time travel should be possible, but the real world application of the theory is much more complicated.

name: Worm Holes
description: Stephen Hawking has written about the possibility that the laws of physics could accommodate the notion of time travel, through portals known as wormholes.

name: Parallel Universes
description: Hawking's many-worlds interpretation, also known as the concept of parallel universes, has been used as a plot device in some capacity on tv shows like "Star Trek"  and "Fringe."

name: Imaginary Time
description: During his interview on HBO's "Last Week Tonight," Stephen Hawking told host John Oliver that imaginary time, or the idea of another direction in space is a concept he wishes more people could grasp and understand.

name: Aliens
description: Famed astrophysicist Stephen Hawking contended that alien life may well exist in a primitive form somewhere in the galaxy and he added that humanity must embrace space exploration, if only to ensure its long-term survival.

name: James Cameron
description: James Cameron responds to Stephen Hawking's latest remarks on alien life visiting Earth.

name: God Particle
description: Hawking is concerned about the potential of the Higgs Boson becoming metastable and its potential catastrophic consequences, though he notes that it won't have an effect any time soon.

name: Hawking Radiation
description: Scientists have come closer than ever before to creating a laboratory-scale imitation of a black hole that emits Hawking radiation, the particles predicted to escape black holes due to quantum mechanical effects.

name: Black Holes
description: British theoretical physicist Stephen Hawking is mentioned in this article about black holes working differently than previously thought, because he was the first to deny their traditional definition.

name: Astrophysics
description: Since his time as a student at Cambridge, Stephen Hawking has revolutionized modern physics. From his theories on the quantum mechanics of how black holes arise to developing a quantum theory of gravity, which would inform our understanding of the universe, his impact is undeniable.

name: Scientists
description: Many place Stephen Hawking in the same lineage as Einstein and Galileo so it is unsurprising that the world's most trusted contemporary scholar would have a few arbitrary connections to his predecessors.

name: Galileo
description: One fact about Stephen Hawking is that he was born on the 300th anniversary of the death of astronomer and physicist Galileo Galilei.

name: Stephen Hawking
description: Hawking is a popular writer. His first book,"A Brief History of Time," was published in 1988 and became an international best seller. In it, Hawking aimed to communicate questions about the birth and death of the universe to the lay person.

name: Isaac Newton
description: After being told by his doctors that he would be dead by his 23rd birthday, Stephen Hawking, Britain’s most famous scientist, defied all odds by living into his retirement from one of the most prestigious academic positions in the world. His position as Cambridge University’s Lucasian Professor of Mathematics was once held by Sir Isaac Newton.

name: Einstein
description: Stephen Hawking has rocked the world of physics by reversing his lifetime’s work to claim that black holes do NOT exist – insisting they're more like 50 shades of grey.

name: Richard Dawkins
description: A clip from the Channel 4 documentary "Genius of Britain" Episode 5.

name: Sir Fred Hoyle
description: This list compiles significant facts about Hawking including the time he interrupted a lecture by renowned astrophysicist Sir Fred Hoyle to let him know that he had made a mistake.

name: Neil deGrasse Tyson
description: Astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson differs with Hawking on the threat of extraterrestrial life and accuses him of perpetuating fear of alien life.

name: Cosmology
description: Of all the big questions Stephen Hawking has posed and sought to answer, none is bigger than the question of how the universe came to exist.

name: M Theory
description: Hawking contends that M-theory could explain the circumstances of  the universe's dense, hot beginning, known as the Big Bang, and the unique characteristics of the cosmos that resulted.

name: The Big Bang
description: "Paste" breaks down how Stephen Hawking's biggest theories have trickled down into plot devices or references in pop culture, including his thoughts on what created the universe and the big bang.

name: Atheism
description: One of Stephen Hawking's most controversial subjects is the creation of the universe, because in his interpretation, there is no room for God or theology.

name: Books
description: Stephen Hawking's first book cemented his status as a genius and he has continued to expand his subject matter in further writings.

name: Science Books
description: Stephen Hawking's notoriety as a living legend began with his first book and has grown deeper with every subsequent publication.

name: Hawking Theories
description: From Cosmology to Math to Black Holes, Stephen Hawking has posed deep questions in his writing.

name: A Brief History of Time
description: Stephen Hawking's essential book, which propelled him from a great mind to an influential world figure, covered a range of topics from the origins of the universe to theories of black holes.

name: A Briefer History of Time
description: A more accessible version of his best-seller that gives even the most novice science readers a chance to read about his deep questions.

name: The Grand Design
description: In this controversial book, Hawking attempts to explain the origins of the universe, leaving God out of the equation.

name: The Universe in a Nutshell
description:
Hawking returns with a lavishly illustrated sequel that unravels the 
mysteries of the major breakthroughs that have occurred in the years 
since the release of his acclaimed first book.

name: Black Holes and Baby Universes
description: Thirteen extraordinary essays shed new light on the mysteries of the universe – and on one of the most brilliant thinkers of our time.

name: The Theories of Others
description: Stephen Hawking is a modern-day genius and philosopher, but that hasn't stopped him from paying tribute in his work and writing to the great minds who came before him

path: The Nature of Space and Time
name: The Nature of Space and Time
description:
Two of the world's most famous physicists-Stephen Hawking and Roger Penrose explain their positions in a work based on six lectures with a final debate, all originally presented at the Isaac Newton Institute for Mathematical Sciences at the 
University of Cambridge.

name: Structure of Space-Time
description: The authors discuss Einstein, the General Theory of Relativity, and its significance.

name: God Created The Integers
description: In this anthology, bestselling author and physicist Stephen Hawking edits excerpts from the most important mathematical works all the way from Euclid to Alan Turing.

name: On The Shoulders of Giants
description: World-renowned physicist and bestselling author Stephen Hawking compiles seven classic works on physics and astronomy to demonstrate their impact on how we live and think.

name: Non-Fiction
description: Stephen Hawking's unbelievable life story, both personally and professionally, made the perfect subject for exploration.

name: An Unfettered Mind
description:
Kitty Ferguson's comprehensive look at Hawking's life, from his childhood, the 
heartbreaking ALS diagnosis. his long and personal battle for survival in pursuit of a scientific understanding of the universe; and his rise to international fame.

name: My Brief History
description:
My Brief History recounts Stephen Hawking’s improbable journey, 
from his post war London boyhood to his years of international acclaim and celebrity.

name: Music to Move the Stars
description: In this compelling memoir, his first wife, Jane Hawking, reveals the secret struggles within her marriage to Stephen Hawking.

name: Traveling to Infinity
description: In her second memoir, Jane Hawking provides insight into her love story with Stephen Hawking from their initial sparks at university to their eventual divorce and reconciliation.

name: Childrens Books
description: Along with his daughter Lucy, Stephen Hawking has created a universe around the character George in order to translate big ideas to younger followers.

name: George and the Unbreakable Code
description: In the most recent sequel in this series, George and his best friend Annie travel further into space than ever before.

name: George and the Big Bang
description:
This engaging adventure story follows George to Switzerland where he looks for clues to an experiment. It even ends 
with a twenty-page graphic novel that explains how the Big Bang 
happened—in reverse!

name: George's Cosmic Treasure Hunt
description:
Based in part on Lucy Hawking's own experiences in zero-gravity flight and interviews 
with astronauts at Cape Kennedy and the Johnson Space Center, this sequel follows George and Annie as they explore space 
travel.

path: George's Secret Key to the Universe
name: George's Secret Key to the Universe
description: It's the story of George, who's taken through the vastness of space by a scientist, his daughter, and their super-computer named Cosmos.

name: Pop Culture
description: The influence of Stephen Hawking extends beyond the scientific microscope. He has an undeniable presence in pop culture and is frequently referenced in films, movies, and books.  A week into joining Facebook, Hawking had attained over a million fans and even participated in the viral Ice Bucket Challenge, proving his sustaining popularity and cultural relevance.

name: Art
description: Stephen Hawking has already left a lasting impression on the scientific community and its future, but he's also been the subject in various art endeavors over the years.

name: David Hockney
description: Artist David Hockney revealed a portrait of Hawking he created with his iPad.

name: Sports
description: Stephen Hawking's physical limits haven't stopped him from participating in the world of sports.

name: World Cup 2014
description: The famous cosmologist identifies red shirts, low altitude and 4-3-3 formation as winning factors in previous World Cups.

name: Paralympics
description: Stephen Hawking opened the 2012 Paralympics in London with his iconic voice to kickstart the ceremonies

name: Rowing
description: Before his debilitating disease rendered him wheelchair bound, Stephen Hawking was a coxswain for his university rowing team.

name: Comics
description: Stephen Hawking's research and writings have made him the hero of nerd culture from Comic-Con to comic books.

name: Stephen Hawking Comic
description: A new comic book gets its action from the tremendous ideas of cosmologist Stephen Hawking.

name: Comic-Con
description: Stephen Hawking made a surprise appearance at  "The Big Bang Theory" panel at the 2013 San Diego Comic-Con, kicking off the event with a pre-recorded video segment taped in his office.

name: Video Games
description: Stephen Hawking's research and persona are so imbedded in our cultural framework that video game characters and frameworks have been based on his ideas or Hawking himself.

name: Shin Megami Tensei
description: This video game, and its sequel feature a character based on Hawking.

name: Mass Effect
description: In the video game series, there is a nebula called "Hawking Eta," and in Mass Effect 3 one of the characters mentions that they served as a fighter pilot aboard a carrier called the "SSV Hawking." This ship is named in honour of Stephen Hawking.

name: Music
description: In addition to being one of the most lauded minds of our time, Stephen Hawking also possesses one of the most recognizable voices on the planet. The English rock band Pink Floyd has featured the cosmologist’s iconic computer-generated voice on two of their records.

name: Pink Floyd
description: Stephen Hawking will bring his iconic synthesized voice to Pink Floyd's new album, The Endless River, set for release in November. It's the famed physicist's second collaboration with the British band, having appeared on the 1994 track "Keep Talkin' " from The Division Bell.

name: Division Bell
description:
Audio samples of Professor Stephen Hawking provide the spoken word portions of "Keep Talking".[2] Gilmour had first heard the professor's words on a BT television advertisement,[5]
 and was so moved by Hawking's sentiment that he contacted the company 
which made the advertisement to get permission to use the recordings on 
the album.

name: Endless River
description: Hawking's artificial voice will appear on the track "Talkin' Hawkin," on Pink Floyd's newest album "Endless River."

name: "Weird Al" Yankovic
description: Weird Al's song parody "White & Nerdy" includes the line, "Stephen Hawking's in my library," and the music video shows the singer reading "A Brief History of Time" at this line.

name: Juno Reactor
description: Hawking is quoted in the track "Landing" from electronica/ambient band Juno Reactor's album Transmissions. (3:35)

name: Philip Glass
description: Errol Morris notes that composer Philip Glass wrote the music for his documentary "A Brief History of Time," in an interview commemorating the film's DVD release.

name: Movies
description: Stephen Hawking’s incredible life story has proved to be the stuff of movie magic. Most recently with the biopic Theory of Everything, which stars Eddie Redmayne as the famed cosmologist. Another illustrious British actor, Benedict Cumberbatch, played Hawking in a 2003 TV Movie based on his life. Additionally, multiple documentaries about his work and personal experiences have been produced.

name: Fiction
description: Stephen Hawking is so imbedded into the cultural landscape that he even exists in film worlds.

name: Interstellar
description:
In Interstellar, the crew debate one another, referring, in passing, to theories advanced by Albert Einstein, Stephen Hawking, and 
Kip Thorne.

name: Michael Caine
description: What does it take for Michael Caine to get star-struck? Meeting Stephen Hawking. And he recently got to do just that. Caine’s work in Christopher Nolan’s new film, Interstellar, gave him the chance to become friendly with theoretical physicist Kip Thorne, who in turn introduced Caine to Hawking.

name: Harry Potter 3
description: An early scene in "Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban" reveals a wizard, played by musician Ian Brown, reading Stephen Hawking's "A Brief History of Time" in the Leaky Cauldron.

name: The Theory of Everything
description: Legendary scientist Stephen Hawking allowed his iconic computer-generated voice to be used in the film after being so impressed by an early screening.

name: Eddie Redmayne
description: Jimmy Fallon talks to Eddie Redmayne about his movie The Theory of Everything and Eddie's nervous first encounter with Stephen Hawking.

name: Felicity Jones
description: Felicity Jones discusses playing Jane Hawking, working with Eddie Redmayne, and portraying Jane with truthfulness and respect.

name: Star Trek - The Next Generation
description: Theoretical physicist Stephen Hawking made a guest appearance on Star Trek: The Next Generation, in a 1993 episode of the show featuring a scene in which the character Data participates in a poker game with a group of brilliant scientific figures consisting of Hawking, Einstein, and Newton.

name: Legally Blonde
description: During Harvard Law School orientation, character Aaron Mitchell, as an example of his own genius, mentions the possibility that "A Brief History of Time" may have been plagiarized from a paper he wrote as a child.

name: Avengers
description: In a superhero movie bursting with pop-culture references, Stephen Hawking is also mentioned during a conversation among the Avengers.

name: Mr. Peabody and Sherman
description: In this review of the children's film, it is revealed that the character Sherman carries a Stephen Hawking “A Brief History of Lunch” lunchbox around his school.

name: Hawking
description: A BBC television film about Stephen Hawking's early years as a PhD student at Cambridge University, following his search for the beginning of time, and his struggle against motor neuron disease. It stars Benedict Cumberbatch as Hawking and premiered in the UK in April 2004.

name: Benedict Cumberbatch
description: In 2004, a few years before a small role in Atonement helped kick off his film career, Cumberbatch played Hawking in the 90-minute made-for-television movie Hawking, which ran on the BBC.

name: Documentaries
description: Stephen Hawking's life has been the subject of exploration in documentary film, but Hawking has been the host and driver of bringing science to life on film.

name: A Brief History of Time
description: Morris’s documentary examines the way the collapse of Hawking’s body has been accompanied by the broadening of his imagination.

name: Hawking
description: Finnigan's documentary is an acutely personal film that tells Stephen Hawking's story from the scientist himself and those closest to him.

name: Into The Universe
description: Johnson reviews Stephen Hawking's documentary series for Discovery, which reveals the mysteries of the universe, tracing all the way back to the beginning.

name: Brave New World
description: Stephen Hawking presented the series, which was broken into five episodes: Machines, Health, Technology, Environment, and Biology to demonstrate current and future breakthroughs in science.

name: The Hawking Paradox
description: Horizon followed Stephen Hawking for a year as he attempted to come to terms with his most controversial theory, while attempting to overcome worsening health issues.

name: TV
description: Stephen Hawking’s appearances on American television in sitcoms like The Big Bang Theory, late night shows like Last Week with John Oliver, and especially his satirical guest spots on Futurama and The Simpsons, are responsible for introducing the scientist to an entire new generation and countless audiences. His prolific TV moments have made him a cultural icon, not just a visionary physicist.

name: Stem Cell Universe
description: Stem Cell Universe With Stephen Hawking is a documentary that explores the science and controversies behind stem cells.

name: Morgan Freeman
description: Morgan Freeman discusses working on Stem Cell Universe with Stephen Hawking on Jimmy Kimmel Live.

name: Comedy
description: Stephen Hawking's animated characters have been instrumental in making the scientist a cultural icon.

name: The Simpsons
description: Stephen Hawking is as well known for his guest appearances on "The Simpsons" as he is for his academic work. The British scientist has played himself on the series and he is lauded as having some of the best jokes on the series.

name: The Simpsons
description: Stephen Hawking discusses how he became involved with "The Simpsons"  and proclaims the show as the best thing on American television.

name: Futurama
description: In Futurama, Stephen Hawking depicts a snarky version of himself who preys on Fry’s stupidity. He provides his own voice for his character.

name: Talk Shows
description: Stephen Hawking's guest appearances on American talk shows have showed the comedic side as well as the scientific side of the astrophysicist.

name: Late Night with Conan O'Brien
description: Olivia Solon discusses the documentary Hawking, which focuses more heavily on Stephen Hawking's life outside of science, including his friendship with Jim Carrey which was displayed in a sketch on Late Night With Conan O'Brien.

name: Larry King Live
description: Hawking describes the subject of his book "The Grand Design" in an interview with Larry King in which he declares theology as unnecessary.

name: 60 Minutes
description: Acclaimed physicist Stephen Hawking told Ed Bradley about his fascination with the mysteries of the universe.

name: John Oliver
description: Stephen Hawking goes toe to toe with John Oliver in an interview covering a range of subjects from science to Charlize Theron.

name: Prime Time
description: Stephen Hawking's endorsement of "The Big Bang Theory" solidified his cultural klout.

name: LOST
description: A Brief History of Time, the book seen being read by Aldo in "Not in Portland", and in Ben's living space in "The Man from Tallahassee".

name: Eloise Hawking
description: Her last name is the same as that of the physicist Stephen Hawking. Her name could be a reference to a book in particular "The Large Scale Structure of Space-Time" by Ellis & Hawking. Similarly, her son's last name, Faraday, is the same as a famous English physicist who researched electromagnetism.

name: The Big Bang Theory
description: After being the object of character Sheldon Cooper's intellectual affection for seasons, Stephen Hawking's guest appearance as himself on "The Big Bang Theory" felt especially satisfying.

name: Doctor Who
description: The creator of Doctor Who, Stephen Moffat, admitted that complex plot points in the show are meant to entertain and confound Stephen Hawking and similarly brilliant people.

name: News
description: As a trusted source of knowledge as well as an influential global figure, when Stephen Hawking announces something, the world listens. Whether he is participating in  a zero-gravity flight or voicing his opinions about the existence of God, Stephen Hawking news is headlined internationally.

name: Zero-gravity flight
description: Hawking's zero-gravity flight was his first time experiencing what space travel might be like, something he hopes to do in the future.

name: The Onion
description: In a fake news post, "The Onion" announced that Nobel Prize-winning physicist Stephen Hawking had stunned the international scientific community by replacing his wheelchair with an extremely expensive and remarkably advanced cybernetic exoskeleton.

name: TED
description: Stephen Hawking asks some Big Questions about our universe — How did the universe begin? How did life begin? Are we alone? — and discusses how we might go about answering them.
